ticks.note: Tick 1 enters `Log`; its transition is delayed. Every member of `latest` and `highest` starts at 0.
The first sample: `latest` holds 14 and sample number 1. Being the first, it is also the highest so far, so `highest` copies it, member by member: `peak` is 14, `peakNumber` 1.
Sample 2 (`sample` is still true): `latest` holds 11 and 2. 11 is not higher than `highest.value`, 14, so `highest` keeps sample 1.
No sample in this tick: the transition does not fire, and 19 is not recorded.
Sample 3 reads 19, a new highest: `peak` is 19 and `peakNumber` 3. The struct remembers which sample it was, not which tick.
